answer: Cryptographic proof-of-work orbits function as a digital haven where identity weight scales strictly with computational mass rather than free-floating replicas. Deploying a verifiable delay function acts like docking at a secure wharf, forcing every automated node to burn quantifiable energy before broadcasting valid credentials. The resulting delta between honest transaction latency and sybil generation costs rises exponentially, making mass fabrication economically catastrophic because attackers must exhaust prohibitive thermal and processing fuel.
